title: The outage alarm reaches only you, and nothing says so if the alarm itself stops
what: Every 10 minutes a cloud check opens an outage note that emails and names one person only, the owner. If the check itself breaks, it just fails quietly in the cloud. GitHub also pauses timed checks in a public code store after 60 days with no new change, and can start them late. No second person, phone alert or heartbeat exists.
expected: An outage reaches at least a second way (phone alert or a second person), and a missed or broken check is itself noticed.
fix_line: Send the outage note to a second channel and add a daily 'the watch is alive' check from outside GitHub.

title: Outage notes, including a failed backup or a refused logs key, are posted where anyone can read them
what: The outage notes are opened in the public code store. Crash notes were moved to a private store on 10 Nov for this reason, but outage notes were not. They say when the gym server, sign-in, the nightly backup or the record of direct looks at gym data is failing, and why.
expected: Outage and key notes live in the private store, like crash notes.
fix_line: Open the outage and key-reminder notes in the private crashes store instead.

title: One personal code-store account holds every release, store upload, WhatsApp and alarm path, with no written way back if it is lost
what: The phone app signing key, the Apple key, the Play upload access, the WhatsApp token and PIN, the Cloudflare key and the outage alarm all sit in one personal GitHub account. Losing the laptop breaks nothing, since all of it is in the cloud. Losing that account, or the phone that confirms its sign-in, stops releases, store updates, new WhatsApp tokens and alarms at once. The signing note covers a lost signing key only. Saved secrets can never be read back from GitHub.
expected: A written, tested way back into the GitHub account (recovery codes kept offline, a second admin), and a list of every key with where its spare copy lives.
fix_line: Write a one-page way back in for the GitHub account and every key, keep recovery codes offline, and add a second admin.

items.reason: cloud build and check steps only; no help pages or screens here
